cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(XLPrivateLexbor LANGUAGES C)
set(xl_originals)
set(xl_overlays)
foreach(xl_name IN ITEMS focus-parser selector-retry empty-inline-style)
  file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../patches/lexbor-${xl_name}.json" xl_patch)
  string(JSON xl_file GET "${xl_patch}" file)
  set(xl_original "${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}/${xl_file}")
  file(READ "${xl_original}" xl_source)
  set(xl_patched "${xl_source}")
  string(JSON xl_count LENGTH "${xl_patch}" replacements)
  math(EXPR xl_last "${xl_count} - 1")
  foreach(xl_index RANGE 0 ${xl_last})
    string(JSON xl_before GET "${xl_patch}" replacements ${xl_index} before)
    string(JSON xl_after GET "${xl_patch}" replacements ${xl_index} after)
    string(FIND "${xl_patched}" "${xl_before}" xl_position)
    if(xl_position LESS 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Lexbor ${xl_name} patch ${xl_index} does not match the locked source")
    endif()
    string(LENGTH "${xl_before}" xl_length)
    math(EXPR xl_end "${xl_position} + ${xl_length}")
    string(SUBSTRING "${xl_patched}" ${xl_end} -1 xl_rest)
    string(FIND "${xl_rest}" "${xl_before}" xl_duplicate)
    if(NOT xl_duplicate LESS 0)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Lexbor ${xl_name} patch ${xl_index} matched more than once")
    endif()
    string(REPLACE "${xl_before}" "${xl_after}" xl_patched "${xl_patched}")
  endforeach()
  set(xl_overlay "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/${xl_name}.c")
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
  set(xl_existing "")
  if(EXISTS "${xl_overlay}")
    file(READ "${xl_overlay}" xl_existing)
  endif()
  if(NOT xl_existing STREQUAL xl_patched)
    file(WRITE "${xl_overlay}" "${xl_patched}")
  endif()
  list(APPEND xl_originals "${xl_original}")
  list(APPEND xl_overlays "${xl_overlay}")
endforeach()
add_subdirectory("${XL_DEPENDENCY_SOURCE}" lexbor)
get_target_property(xl_sources lexbor_static SOURCES)
foreach(xl_original IN LISTS xl_originals)
  list(FIND xl_sources "${xl_original}" xl_source_index)
  if(xl_source_index LESS 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Lexbor source list no longer contains a locked patched source")
  endif()
  list(REMOVE_ITEM xl_sources "${xl_original}")
endforeach()
list(APPEND xl_sources ${xl_overlays})
set_property(TARGET lexbor_static PROPERTY SOURCES "${xl_sources}")
